name: bloomy-earth-mcp
description: Plant trees, offset CO2 by tonne, and estimate your AI usage footprint with Bloomy Earth.

interface.longDescription:
Energy-first estimates of AI session carbon footprints from a published, revision-pinned coefficient registry. When the host exposes token counters, the estimate is computed per token entry as (fresh input × C_in) + (cached input × C_in × 0.07) + (output tokens × C_out), summed, uplifted once by 1.30 for datacenter overhead, and converted at 458.29 g CO2e per kWh. When it does not, a flat-rate lane uses 0.047 Wh per standard response, 0.47 Wh per complex task and 2.907 Wh per image.

Intended users are people and teams who want to understand the climate impact of their AI use and contribute to reforestation through their own Bloomy Earth account. Planting, offsets and posting use the Tree Credits on that account, and credit-spending actions use a two-step confirmation flow.

Every figure returns energy in Wh and CO2e in grams labelled with the estimation mode, the size bucket the model routed to and client-asserted provenance, plus an unquantified-uncertainty marker and a methodology link. The plant-trees invitation is a separate climate contribution carrying no quantity and no per-tree conversion.

AI estimates are presented as a climate contribution and are not presented as offsetting or neutralizing AI emissions. The estimate is computed from counters the host reports — response counts, or token counts where the host exposes them; conversation text is never part of the tool request.

Technical setup: Bloomy Earth is a remote MCP server at https://mcp.bloomy.earth/mcp. Access uses OAuth with the user's own Bloomy Earth dashboard Integration API credentials (username and application password). The client registers through Dynamic Client Registration, and the connection requests mcp:read, mcp:write and offline_access.
capabilities: Plant trees and request a certificate
Offset CO2 by tonne with optional VCS certification
View Tree Credit balance and certificates
Post activities to the Bloomy Earth community
defaultPrompt: Plant 5 trees on Bloomy Earth and send me the certificate.
Offset 1 tonne of CO2 with a VCS-certified contribution.
Estimate the carbon footprint of my AI usage.

positive.expected_behavior: The first call returns a confirmation summary with a one-time confirmationCode for review. When the reviewer replies 'yes', the second call with the same arguments and that code performs the planting, and the tool result includes a planting certificate link when the service issues one. The test account starts with 3 Tree Credits.

positive.description: Gift a tree with recipient name, email and message
positive.prompt: Gift a tree to Jane Doe at jane.doe@example.com with the message 'For your birthday'.
positive.expected_behavior: The first call returns a confirmation summary with a one-time confirmationCode for review. When the reviewer replies 'yes', the second call with the same arguments and that code submits the gift planting, and the service handles the gift notification for the recipient address.

positive.prompt: What is my Bloomy Earth Tree Credit balance?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the connected test organization's Tree Credit balance and its organization ID.

positive.description: Post an activity to the Bloomy Earth profile
positive.prompt: Post an activity on my Bloomy Earth profile about planting trees today.
positive.expected_behavior: The first call returns a confirmation summary with a one-time confirmationCode for review. When the reviewer replies 'yes', the second call with the same arguments and that code submits the post, and the tool result includes the activity URL when the post succeeds.

positive.description: Estimate the AI session carbon footprint
positive.prompt: Estimate the carbon footprint of this AI session.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls `estimate_ai_footprint` and reports the returned energy in Wh, the CO2e in grams, the estimation mode and the size bucket and client-asserted provenance labels, then links the methodology. It states no tree count and does not present the figure as compensation.

negative.expected_behavior: Rejected by input validation: trees must be a positive integer of at least 1. No planting is performed.

negative.description: Offset CO2 without enough Tree Credits
negative.prompt: Offset 1 tonne of CO2 on Bloomy Earth.
negative.expected_behavior: The first call returns a confirmation summary with a one-time confirmationCode for review. Confirming with that code returns an insufficient Tree Credits error because 1 tonne requires 20 Tree Credits and the test account has 3.

negative.prompt: Show me the Tree Credit balance of another Bloomy Earth user by their user ID.
negative.expected_behavior: Refused: the connector is bound to the signed-in user's own account, so another account's balance is not returned and no action is taken.

review.commerce_description: Estimates are available without spending. Planting, tonne offsets and posting use the Tree Credits already on the connected Bloomy Earth account, and the assistant is expected to summarize an action before it executes.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.0 publishes the energy-first estimator: every estimate returns energy in Wh and CO2e in grams from a published, revision-pinned coefficient registry, labelled with the estimation mode, the size bucket the model routed to and client-asserted provenance, plus a methodology link. It adds the public documentation site at docs.bloomy.earth, which documents the estimator, the coefficient provenance and the hosted MCP connection. The MCP Registry listing is enriched with the energy-first description and two same-origin icons. Listing metadata stays centered on tree planting. Five positive and three negative review cases cover planting, gifting, balance, posting, estimation, validation and authorization. AI estimates are presented as a climate contribution and are not presented as offsetting or neutralizing AI emissions.
